review_method: Manual inspection of five high-resolution intake originals and the additional original NXP macro photo with enlarged package crops. Two additional full-board ESP32 originals were reviewed by robust planar registration to the first annotated original, then visually checked in target-resolution overlays.
scope: Known photographed specimens; board-body feature regions, 60 literal printed contacts, three readable part/module families, four named NXP mounting-hole image/metric landmark pairs. This is not exhaustive training annotation. Eight additional NXP masks on the macro photo cover U1, U8, U12, J3, J4, J5, J6 and SW3. Rev C links remain source candidates; installed identities and photographed PCB revision are unconfirmed. Four new ESP32 labels add a shielded RF module, Micro-USB receptacle and BOOT/EN switches alongside the previously reviewed U2; module identity and switch refdes remain unknown. The five chosen ESP32 body classes (U2 IC, shielded RF module, Micro-USB receptacle, BOOT and EN switches) are reviewed in three full-board originals (15 masks); two derived macro crops remain outside this three-photo annotation group to avoid duplicate/crop leakage. Contact aliases and board identity remain separate metadata.
